lines.zh: 基纽踏着舞台般的步子走来
lines.en: Ginyu advances with a performer's stride.

lines.zh: 他每一步都踩得很准
lines.en: Every step lands with precision.

lines.zh: 紫色的身躯在光影里移动
lines.en: A purple frame moves through the light.

lines.zh: 他双角朝前，下巴抬着
lines.en: Horns forward, chin high.

lines.zh: 他走得从容，像在巡视
lines.en: He walks as if inspecting his own arena.

lines.zh: 脚底的气流微微托着他
lines.en: A thin cushion of ki lifts each step.

lines.zh: 他绕着你走，保持距离
lines.en: He circles, keeping his distance.

lines.zh: 他的披风随动作轻轻扬起
lines.en: His mantle lifts lightly with each move.

lines.zh: 他忽然加速，又立刻停住
lines.en: He bursts forward, then halts.

lines.zh: 他的脚步落点全在一条线上
lines.en: His footfalls line up perfectly.

lines.zh: 他摆动双臂，摆出姿势
lines.en: He swings his arms into a pose.

lines.zh: 他一步步把你逼到空地上
lines.en: He walks you out into the open.

lines.zh: 基纽站着，慢慢活动手腕
lines.en: Ginyu stands, rolling his wrists.

lines.zh: 他抬手理了理自己的角
lines.en: He raises a hand to his horns.

lines.zh: 他摆出一个蓄势的架势
lines.en: He settles into a charging stance.

lines.zh: 他的气在皮肤下轻轻流动
lines.en: His ki ripples just under the skin.

lines.zh: 他侧头，像在听你的心跳
lines.en: He tilts his head as if hearing your pulse.

lines.zh: 他忽然笑了一下，很短
lines.en: A short laugh escapes him.

lines.zh: 他把拳头握了握，骨节作响
lines.en: He flexes a fist; knuckles pop.

lines.zh: 他原地转身，披风甩开
lines.en: He turns in place, mantle flaring.

lines.zh: 他检查自己的护腕
lines.en: He checks his wrist guard.

lines.zh: 他仰头吸了一口气
lines.en: He lifts his head and draws a breath.

lines.zh: 他的注意力一直没散
lines.en: His focus never drifts.

lines.zh: 他脚尖点地，试着弹性
lines.en: He taps the ground, testing its spring.

lines.zh: 他压低重心，做出起跑的样子
lines.en: He sinks low as if to launch.

lines.zh: 他站得像一尊雕像，却在发光
lines.en: He stands statue-still, yet glowing.

lines.zh: 基纽上下打量你，很满意
lines.en: Ginyu sizes you up with pleasure.

lines.zh: 他把你和某个数值比了比
lines.en: He compares you to some number.

lines.zh: 他的眼睛眯起来，像在称重
lines.en: His eyes narrow, weighing you.

lines.zh: 他往前半步，凑近看
lines.en: He steps in for a closer look.

lines.zh: 他抬起下巴，等你先说话
lines.en: Chin lifted, he waits for you to speak.

lines.zh: 他扫过你的手、腰和脚
lines.en: His gaze sweeps hands, belt, feet.

lines.zh: 他笑出了声，不怀好意
lines.en: He laughs, and it is not friendly.

lines.zh: 他指了指你，又指了指自己
lines.en: He points at you, then at himself.

lines.zh: 他摆了个姿势，像在开演
lines.en: He strikes a pose, beginning the show.

lines.zh: 他被你逗乐了，摇着头
lines.en: Amused by you, he shakes his head.

lines.zh: 他侧身站好，等你出手
lines.en: He turns side-on, inviting your move.

lines.zh: 他的目光停在你的咽喉
lines.en: His eyes rest on your throat.

lines.zh: 他伸出手，像在邀舞
lines.en: He offers a hand as if to dance.

lines.zh: 他的表情说明他没把你当回事
lines.en: His face says you are not worth much.

lines.zh: 他低声念出你的身高体重
lines.en: He murmurs your height and weight.

lines.zh: 他抬眼看你，笑意收干净了
lines.en: He looks up, the smile gone.

lines.zh: 他把你归进了“热身”那一类
lines.en: He files you under warm-up.

lines.zh: 他盯着你，像盯一件战利品
lines.en: He stares like you are a trophy.

lines.zh: 基纽挨了一下，退了半步
lines.en: Ginyu takes the hit and gives half a step.

lines.zh: 他擦了擦嘴角，笑意不减
lines.en: He wipes his mouth, still smiling.

lines.zh: 他的身体晃了晃，很快站定
lines.en: He sways, then steadies fast.

lines.zh: 气在他周身短暂地乱了一下
lines.en: His aura briefly frays.

lines.zh: 他吐出一口气，调整呼吸
lines.en: He exhales and resets his breathing.

lines.zh: 伤口处的护甲裂开了
lines.en: The armour plate at the wound splits.

lines.zh: 他眯眼看你，重新评估
lines.en: He squints and re-evaluates you.

lines.zh: 他抬手摸了摸被击中的地方
lines.en: He touches where he was struck.

lines.zh: 他退了半步，随即又逼近
lines.en: He yields a step, then presses back in.

lines.zh: 他的架势散了一瞬又收回
lines.en: His stance breaks for a moment, then returns.

lines.zh: 基纽看了看你手上的东西
lines.en: Ginyu glances at what you hold.

lines.zh: 他伸手，姿态很随意
lines.en: He reaches out, casually.

lines.zh: 他闻了闻，眉头动了一下
lines.en: He sniffs; one brow lifts.

lines.zh: 他把东西掂了掂，收下
lines.en: He weighs it in hand and keeps it.

lines.zh: 他对这点东西并不满足
lines.en: This much does not satisfy him.

lines.zh: 他勾了勾手指，意思很明确
lines.en: He curls a finger: give it here.

lines.zh: 他接过食物，一口吞下
lines.en: He takes the food and swallows it whole.

lines.zh: 他吃东西时也保持着架势
lines.en: He keeps his stance even while eating.

lines.zh: 他舔了舔手指，看你还有没有
lines.en: He licks a finger, checking for more.

lines.zh: 他收下东西，却没说声谢
lines.en: He takes it without thanks.

lines.zh: 你撞上基纽的肩，像撞铁
lines.en: You hit Ginyu's shoulder like iron.

lines.zh: 他纹丝不动，只是低头看你
lines.en: He does not move; only looks down.

lines.zh: 他侧身一让，你冲过头
lines.en: He sidesteps and you overshoot.

lines.zh: 他用前臂把你的手挡开
lines.en: His forearm knocks your hand aside.

lines.zh: 他的气把你推得退了半步
lines.en: His aura pushes you back a step.

lines.zh: 他勾住你的脚，你差点摔
lines.en: He hooks your ankle; you nearly fall.

lines.zh: 他撞回来时力道十足
lines.en: He bumps back with real force.

lines.zh: 他抬手，把你挡在一臂之外
lines.en: One arm keeps you at arm's length.

lines.zh: 他被撞后只笑了下
lines.en: He only smiles at the impact.

lines.zh: 他退开半步，重新摆位
lines.en: He gives half a step and resets.

lines.zh: 基纽与同伴对了一个姿势
lines.en: Ginyu and his comrade strike a pose.

lines.zh: 两人同时抬手、转身、定住
lines.en: Both raise, turn, and freeze.

lines.zh: 他们的气在同一个节拍上
lines.en: Their ki pulses on the same beat.

lines.zh: 他搭住对方的肩，笑得很响
lines.en: He claps a shoulder and laughs loud.

lines.zh: 他替对方整了整护腕
lines.en: He adjusts his partner's wrist guard.

lines.zh: 他们并列站着，像在受阅
lines.en: They stand abreast, as if on parade.

lines.zh: 他们对视一下，同时点头
lines.en: A glance, and both nod.

lines.zh: 基纽让出半步，把中间留给对方
lines.en: Ginyu yields the centre place.

lines.zh: 他们的呼吸很快同步了
lines.en: Their breathing syncs quickly.

lines.zh: 这是队伍里才有的默契
lines.en: This is a squad's own understanding.

lines.zh: 基纽随手把东西拾起来
lines.en: Ginyu picks the thing up offhand.

lines.zh: 他举起来，对着光看了看
lines.en: He holds it to the light.

lines.zh: 他把它抛起又接住
lines.en: He tosses it and catches it.

lines.zh: 他塞进腰带，一点都不小心
lines.en: He stuffs it in his sash carelessly.

lines.zh: 他捏了捏，判断值不值钱
lines.en: He squeezes it, judging its worth.

lines.zh: 他把没用的丢到身后
lines.en: What is useless, he tosses behind him.

lines.zh: 他单脚踩住滑来的物品
lines.en: He traps a sliding item underfoot.

lines.zh: 他弯腰的姿势依然很好看
lines.en: Even bending down, he keeps form.

lines.zh: 他拾起战利品举过头顶
lines.en: He lifts his prize overhead.

lines.zh: 他收好之后立刻看向你
lines.en: Stowed, his eyes snap back to you.

lines.zh: 基纽的气忽然暴涨
lines.en: Ginyu's ki surges suddenly.

lines.zh: 脚下的地面被压出裂纹
lines.en: Cracks spread from under his feet.

lines.zh: 他抬手，双指并到额前
lines.en: He raises two fingers to his brow.

lines.zh: 他的笑收住了
lines.en: His smile switches off.

lines.zh: 一股冲击以他为中心散开
lines.en: A shockwave bursts outward from him.

lines.zh: 他把重心压到前脚
lines.en: His weight shifts to the front foot.

lines.zh: 他的眼睛不再眨了
lines.en: He stops blinking.

lines.zh: 空气开始往他那边流
lines.en: The air starts pulling toward him.

lines.zh: 他摆出了进攻的起手
lines.en: He sets into an attack opening.

lines.zh: 碎石被气流托着浮起来
lines.en: Gravel lifts on the rising current.

lines.zh: 他轻声报出一个数字
lines.en: He murmurs a number.

lines.zh: 那一瞬间，他认真了
lines.en: In that instant, he is serious.

lines.zh: 他选定你为目标，不再观望
lines.en: He has chosen his target.

lines.zh: 他的指尖聚起一点白光
lines.en: A point of white light gathers at his fingertips.

lines.zh: 他把披风甩到身后
lines.en: He throws his mantle back.

lines.zh: 他冲出的前一瞬，风先到了
lines.en: The wind arrives before his charge.

lines.zh: 基纽绕着你走，步伐轻快
lines.en: Ginyu circles with a light step.

lines.zh: 他忽然从你视野里消失
lines.en: He vanishes from your sight.

lines.zh: 他的残影还站在原地
lines.en: His afterimage lingers where he stood.

lines.zh: 下一瞬他已在你侧面
lines.en: Next instant he is at your side.

lines.zh: 他试探性地出一记快拳
lines.en: He flicks out a testing jab.

lines.zh: 他在等你的反应速度
lines.en: He is measuring your reaction.

lines.zh: 他压低身体，贴地逼近
lines.en: He drops low and closes in.

lines.zh: 他的气在你背后聚起
lines.en: Ki gathers behind you.

lines.zh: 他笑着，但目光很冷
lines.en: He smiles, but his eyes stay cold.

lines.zh: 他一步步收窄你的空间
lines.en: He narrows your space step by step.

lines.zh: 他抬手，掌心朝你
lines.en: He raises a palm toward you.

lines.zh: 他换了个角度再逼近
lines.en: He shifts angle and presses again.

lines.zh: 他不急着结束这场戏
lines.en: He is in no hurry to end the show.

lines.zh: 他把你逼到背对石壁
lines.en: He backs you against the stone.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸稳得像机械
lines.en: His breathing stays machine-steady.

lines.zh: 你一动，他就已经在那了
lines.en: You move, and he is already there.

lines.zh: 他在数你还能撑几下
lines.en: He is counting how many hits you have left.

lines.zh: 他轻轻活动了一下脖子
lines.en: He rolls his neck once.

lines.zh: 基纽一记直拳打在你护甲上
lines.en: Ginyu's straight punch cracks your armour.

lines.zh: 他连出三拳，节奏极快
lines.en: Three punches in a blistering rhythm.

lines.zh: 他一脚扫来，你腾空半格
lines.en: A sweep sends you off your feet.

lines.zh: 他抬膝顶在你的肋下
lines.en: A knee drives under your ribs.

lines.zh: 他抓住你的手腕，往怀里带
lines.en: He hooks your wrist and pulls you in.

lines.zh: 他掌根推在你胸口
lines.en: His palm heel slams your chest.

lines.zh: 他打完立刻后撤半步
lines.en: He strikes, then slips back half a step.

lines.zh: 他借转身的力加了一记肘击
lines.en: His spin adds weight to the elbow.

lines.zh: 他踢你的膝弯，让你跪下
lines.en: A kick to the back of the knee drops you.

lines.zh: 他的拳头带起一圈气浪
lines.en: His fist carries a ring of pressure.

lines.zh: 他打空了一拳，却毫无破绽
lines.en: One punch misses; nothing else opens up.

lines.zh: 他连着两次假动作才出手
lines.en: Two feints precede the real blow.

lines.zh: 他把你按在石上，又松开
lines.en: He pins you to the stone, then lets go.

lines.zh: 他的动作快得只剩声音
lines.en: All that is left of his motion is sound.

lines.zh: 收势时他还对你点了点头
lines.en: He even nods at you as he resets.

lines.zh: 这一记得手，他更兴奋了
lines.en: Landing it only makes him keener.

lines.zh: 半空中亮起一团白光
lines.en: A ball of white light blooms in the air.

lines.zh: 基纽从光里落下，双角朝前
lines.en: Ginyu drops from the light, horns forward.

lines.zh: 落地时冲击掀翻一圈草皮
lines.en: His landing peels back a ring of turf.

lines.zh: 他站直身子，披风缓缓落下
lines.en: He straightens as his mantle settles.

lines.zh: 他先摆了个姿势，才看你
lines.en: He strikes a pose before noticing you.

lines.zh: 气浪把周围的尘土推开
lines.en: His aura blows the dust outward.

lines.zh: 他活动着肩膀，像刚热身完
lines.en: He rolls his shoulders as if warmed up.

lines.zh: 他从高空缓缓飘下来
lines.en: He floats down from high above.

lines.zh: 他的脚印深得反常
lines.en: His footprints sink unnaturally deep.

lines.zh: 他抬头，看了看这片地方
lines.en: He looks up and surveys the place.

lines.zh: 他的气把落叶卷起来打转
lines.en: His ki sets the leaves spinning.

lines.zh: 他出现时没有半点预兆
lines.en: He arrives with no warning at all.

lines.zh: 他落地的声音只有一下
lines.en: He lands with a single sound.

lines.zh: 他把双手交叠，活动指节
lines.en: He laces his fingers and cracks them.

lines.zh: 他对着空气笑了两声
lines.en: He laughs twice at nothing.

lines.zh: 他站定时，四周都安静了
lines.en: When he stands still, everything goes quiet.

lines.zh: 他的战斗力读数高得离谱
lines.en: His power reading is absurd.

lines.zh: 我的气一收，尘土落定。
lines.en: My ki settles; the dust falls.

lines.zh: 火焰烧到皮肤，他皱眉甩手
lines.en: Flame touches skin; he frowns and shakes it off.

lines.zh: 坠地时他用单手撑住了地面
lines.en: He lands on one hand to break the fall.

lines.zh: 水里他憋着气，脸色变了
lines.en: Underwater, holding his breath, his face changes.

lines.zh: 爆炸把他掀得滑退好几格
lines.en: The blast slides him back several blocks.

lines.zh: 箭扎进肩头，他顺手拔掉
lines.en: An arrow strikes his shoulder; he plucks it out.

lines.zh: 怪力钻入体内，他闷哼一声
lines.en: Odd force enters him; he grunts.

lines.zh: 饿着打，他的动作慢了一拍
lines.en: Fighting hungry, his timing slips a beat.

lines.zh: 雷电劈在身上，他咬牙挺住
lines.en: Lightning hits; he grits his teeth and stands.

lines.zh: 虚空吸住他，他奋力上冲
lines.en: The void pulls; he blasts upward to escape.
